desk:
**BLUF:** The community focused on Israel’s high-turnout election and its regional ripple effects, alongside NATO sustainment moves and Middle East maritime tensions. The single most important thread is the Israeli vote, with analysts tracking turnout and betting markets for a potential Netanyahu ouster.

## MAIN THREADS
### Israeli Election
- @sentdefender reported 55.7% turnout by 4 p.m. local time—the highest since 1973—and noted Polymarket giving former IDF chief Gadi Eisenkot a 64% chance of becoming prime minister. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115135084798095573)
- @sentdefender and @Osinttechnical both highlighted the record turnout and its significance as a referendum on Netanyahu. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115107955959865569)

### Poland PAC-3 Facility
- @sentdefender detailed the Pentagon’s selection of Poland to host a European PAC-3 missile maintenance facility, with Germany, Netherlands and Sweden leading integration. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115132223301030197)

### UK Middle East Travel Warning
- @Osinttechnical flagged a sudden one-sentence UK Foreign Office update: “The context in the Middle East remains deeply unpredictable and the risk of sudden escalation is high.” [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2115121815706280021)

### Hormuz/Oran Blockade
- @sentdefender relayed CENTCOM’s denial of IRGC-N claims that U.S. vessels had retreated from the Strait of Hormuz, confirming the 100+ day Oran blockade continues with 138 vessels redirected. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115077774410981506)

### Nordic Leaders’ Calls
- @sentdefender reported Finnish President Stubb and Norwegian PM Støre spoke with both Putin and Zelenskyy about upcoming Abu Dhabi technical talks. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115043495148695804)

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- Ukraine’s 1039th Air Defense Regiment released a compilation video of French Crotale SAMs downing Russian targets (unconfirmed). [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2114964394811494692)
- U.S. Navy hosted ROKS Hansando at NAS Pensacola (unconfirmed). [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115140118554001696)

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching final Israeli results and any immediate regional reaction; next moves in Abu Dhabi talks; and whether the UK warning signals further escalation.
